explication: Feynman is an AI research agent and local science workbench. A user invokes the CLI with a research, ranking, paper, replication, recipe, or server command. CLI dispatches into Pi-backed model execution and research tools, which query scientific sources, normalize evidence, and return cited results. The optional workbench serves projects, chat, artifacts, notebooks, compute, and review through a local HTTP server and web UI, persisting state in an org SQLite database. The graph emphasizes sampled runtime paths; many individual database connectors are represented by their shared registries.
